title: Prove a sharp native cost floor for six-bank cleanup
body:
## Summary

- Proves the earlier six-bank cleanup needs **22f native mass for every f>=2** when responses are products of the actual K/W operators and disjoint fresh T, even with arbitrary scalar bank coupling and literally restored same-volume dirty helpers. The existing word attains the bound; the proposed 16f suffix is excluded in this class.
- Establishes the missing represented-algebra step with separate exact tensor-square certificates. A retained f1 zero-relation counterexample rejects extending the sign-twist argument unconditionally. [Proof and scope](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd0f22abce2b74d7d080a2e640c0f495d3d2c3aa/research/cut58-separable-query-floor/PROOF.md).

## Scope and limits

This changes the earlier cut's scalar topology, beyond the predecessor's fixed graphs and later-cut floor. It covers only the generated separable response alphabet and fixed arbitrary-input endpoint. Outside-group native/address/frame adapters, cross-coordinate mixing, changed gauges/volumes, partial queries and different prefixes remain open. The unchanged 54f prefix gives whole native mass>=76f against stock 72f; the fixed-normalization native moment is already unfavorable. No positive supplier, compatible BIT, full physical/precision/controller/storage admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change. The result combines a written all-parameter proof with finite exact certificates and separate AI checks; it is not human or formal-kernel acceptance.

- [x] Isolated normal/optimized primary and separate action-table checks: complete group tariffs, Gram modulo 101 versus matrix-entry minor modulo five, the f1 counterexample, all 36 endpoint blocks, Gaussian tensor phases, both inverse orders and defect controls. [Commands](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd0f22abce2b74d7d080a2e640c0f495d3d2c3aa/research/cut58-separable-query-floor/README.md#reproduce).
- [x] Exact committed bytes and source ancestry: `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/cut58-separable-query-floor --check-source-history`. Original predecessor bytes are retained in a source-only ancestor; cold replay needs no cached unmerged commit.
- [x] Official export/integrity plus read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay with empty PATH; bytes, modes and inodes unchanged. The orchestration wrapper is local-only; all mathematical commands and inputs are public.
- [ ] Natural [Registered research packages run39285873484](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39285873484) is queued at last readback for this exact head; hosted success is unconfirmed. No check rerun or workflow dispatch requested.
